lines.zh: 我踏浪而行，水刚好到腰。
lines.en: I walk on the swell, water reaching my waist.

lines.zh: 每走一步，脚下就浮起一圈涟漪。
lines.en: Each step lifts a ring of ripples beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 暴风推着浪，我顺着浪走。
lines.en: The storm drives the waves, and I walk with them.

lines.zh: 我的袍角在水里拖成一片淡蓝。
lines.en: My robe hem trails pale blue through the water.

lines.zh: 我不急，水会把我送到该去的地方。
lines.en: I do not hurry; the water carries me where it should go.

lines.zh: 湿透的布贴在身上，比铠甲还重。
lines.en: Soaked cloth clings to me, heavier than armor.

lines.zh: 我沿浅滩走，脚趾感受沙的坡度。
lines.en: I walk the shallows, toes reading the slope of sand.

lines.zh: 水退一步，我就跟进一步。
lines.en: When the water withdraws a step, I follow it.

lines.zh: 我身后没有脚印，只有散开的水纹。
lines.en: I leave no footprints, only rings spreading outward.

lines.zh: 浪声很大，盖住了我的脚步声。
lines.en: The surf is loud and covers the sound of my steps.

lines.zh: 我走在水面与水面之间。
lines.en: I walk between one surface of water and another.

lines.zh: 潮水漫过膝盖，我照样往前走。
lines.en: The tide rises past my knees, and I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我绕开水草，不想缠住袍子。
lines.en: I skirt the kelp so it will not snag my robe.

lines.zh: 风暴越近，我走得越稳。
lines.en: The closer the storm comes, the steadier I walk.

lines.zh: 我拨开水面的浮沫往前走
lines.en: I part the surface foam and walk on

lines.zh: 浪退下去，我踩在湿沙上
lines.en: The wave pulls back, and I step onto wet sand

lines.zh: 我在水里站定，让浪替我呼吸。
lines.en: I stand still in the water and let waves breathe for me.

lines.zh: 我数着水面上的雨点，一个一个。
lines.en: I count raindrops on the surface, one by one.

lines.zh: 我的指尖在水里画符文，很快就散。
lines.en: My fingertips draw runes in water, and they scatter.

lines.zh: 我在礁石上晾袍子，怎么都晾不干。
lines.en: I hang my robe on the reef, and it never dries.

lines.zh: 海晶碎片在掌心发凉，像一小块冰。
lines.en: Prismarine shards cool my palm like little ice.

lines.zh: 我听见深水里有东西在动。
lines.en: I hear something moving in the deep water.

lines.zh: 暴风的云压得很低，我不抬头。
lines.en: Storm clouds press low, and I do not look up.

lines.zh: 我哼一段潮汐的调子，走调了。
lines.en: I hum a tide-song, and it comes out wrong.

lines.zh: 湿布上的破口，我又撕大了一点。
lines.en: I tear the hole in my wet cloth a little wider.

lines.zh: 水让我安静，一安静就想起旧事。
lines.en: Water quiets me, and quiet brings old things back.

lines.zh: 我把手浸在水里，等它变蓝。
lines.en: I soak my hands and wait for them to turn blue.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，鱼就游到我脚边。
lines.en: I hold still, and fish come to my feet.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水退回原来的位置。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to return to where it was.

lines.zh: 浪打上来，把我说的话冲走了。
lines.en: A wave comes up and washes my words away.

lines.zh: 你在干地上站着，我在浪里抬头。
lines.en: You stand on dry ground; I lift my eyes from the swell.

lines.zh: 你的靴子湿了，你自己还没发现。
lines.en: Your boots are soaked, and you have not noticed.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，淡蓝的光在瞳里转动。
lines.en: I look up, pale blue light turning in my eyes.

lines.zh: 别看我手里的符文，看我身后的水。
lines.en: Do not watch the rune; watch the water behind me.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在水面上，我记住了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the water, and I memorize it.

lines.zh: 我在你脸上找害怕，还没找到。
lines.en: I search your face for fear and have not found it.

lines.zh: 你退到礁石边，那里水很深。
lines.en: You back toward the reef, where the water runs deep.

lines.zh: 我看你时，浪也停了半拍。
lines.en: When I look at you, the waves pause half a beat.

lines.zh: 你的名字被水带走了，我没听清。
lines.en: The water carried your name off before I heard it.

lines.zh: 我歪头，水从发梢滴下来。
lines.en: I tilt my head, and water drips from my hair.

lines.zh: 你的刀劈开湿布，割到了里面。
lines.en: Your blade splits the wet cloth and cuts inside.

lines.zh: 疼，雨水一冲就没那么疼了。
lines.en: It hurts, and the rain washes some of it away.

lines.zh: 我退开，血在水里散成淡红。
lines.en: I withdraw, and my blood spreads pale red in the water.

lines.zh: 这一箭穿透袍子，钉在肩上。
lines.en: The arrow pierces my robe and sticks in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我咬牙，嘴里全是海水味。
lines.en: I clench my teeth, my mouth full of seawater.

lines.zh: 你打中我了，我记住这个距离。
lines.en: You hit me; I will remember this distance.

lines.zh: 我倒退，浪又把我推回来。
lines.en: I stagger back, and the wave pushes me forward again.

lines.zh: 别补刀，我还没沉下去。
lines.en: Do not finish me; I have not sunk yet.

lines.zh: 我的手在抖，符文没有散。
lines.en: My hand shakes, but the rune holds.

lines.zh: 这一下让我把射程缩短了。
lines.en: That blow made me shorten my range.

lines.zh: 你把食物举在水面上，真可笑。
lines.en: You hold food above the water. How foolish.

lines.zh: 我不吃这个，我吃潮水里的光。
lines.en: I do not eat that; I feed on light in the tide.

lines.zh: 你手里的水符文，我认得。
lines.en: I recognize the water runes in your hand.

lines.zh: 别晃了，我只看水里那一点蓝。
lines.en: Stop waving it; I only watch the blue under the water.

lines.zh: 食物会沉，符文会浮，你选错了。
lines.en: Food sinks, runes float. You chose wrong.

lines.zh: 我靠近不是饿了，是想看你会不会游。
lines.en: I come closer to see whether you can swim.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我就把你拖下水。
lines.en: Feed me, and I will drag you under.

lines.zh: 海晶的味道，比面包好得多。
lines.en: Prismarine tastes far better than bread.

lines.zh: 我不碰陆上的东西，它们都太干。
lines.en: I touch nothing from land; it is all too dry.

lines.zh: 把那块布给我，我缺一块补袍子。
lines.en: Give me that cloth; my robe needs a patch.

lines.zh: 你撞进水里，浪替我接住你。
lines.en: You crash into the water, and the wave catches you.

lines.zh: 我的袍子很滑，你抓不住。
lines.en: My robe is slick; you cannot get a grip.

lines.zh: 一撞，水花溅了你满脸。
lines.en: One bump and water sprays across your face.

lines.zh: 我比水重一点，比你轻一点。
lines.en: I am a little heavier than water, a little lighter than you.

lines.zh: 别贴着我，湿布会缠上你的手。
lines.en: Do not press close; wet cloth winds around your hand.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，水把这个声音吞了。
lines.en: We collide, and the water swallows the sound.

lines.zh: 你推我，我顺着浪退开。
lines.en: You shove me, and I slide away with the swell.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤凉，你碰一下会缩手。
lines.en: My skin is cold; one touch makes you pull back.

lines.zh: 水里的碰撞，总是慢半拍。
lines.en: Collisions in water always arrive half a beat late.

lines.zh: 再挤，我就把你按进浅滩。
lines.en: Push again, and I will pin you in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我们在深水里相遇，只交换符文。
lines.en: We meet in deep water and trade only runes.

lines.zh: 潮水涨起来的时候，我们才成对。
lines.en: We pair only when the tide rises.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣住在暴云下面。
lines.en: My partner lives beneath the storm clouds.

lines.zh: 两件湿袍子缠在一起，就算婚礼。
lines.en: Two wet robes tangled together count as a wedding.

lines.zh: 我们没有誓言，只有同一片海。
lines.en: We have no vows, only the same sea.

lines.zh: 分开时，各自带走半枚海晶。
lines.en: We part, each carrying half a prismarine shard.

lines.zh: 水里的爱很慢，像退潮。
lines.en: Love in water is slow, like an ebbing tide.

lines.zh: 我独自游过了很多个潮汐。
lines.en: I have swum alone through many tides.

lines.zh: 谁想与我成对，先学会不呼吸。
lines.en: Whoever would pair with me must first learn not to breathe.

lines.zh: 我们不在岸上久留，岸会把人晾干。
lines.en: We never linger ashore; the land dries us out.

lines.zh: 我很少捡，水里什么都拿不稳。
lines.en: I rarely pick things up; water keeps nothing steady.

lines.zh: 海晶碎片落进沙里，我摸到了。
lines.en: A prismarine shard fell in the sand, and I found it.

lines.zh: 这块布不错，正好补我的袖口。
lines.en: This cloth is good; it will patch my cuff.

lines.zh: 我捡起符文，水就从指缝漏走。
lines.en: I lift a rune, and water leaks between my fingers.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西太干了，我不捡。
lines.en: What you dropped is too dry; I leave it.

lines.zh: 我用袍角兜着，比手好使。
lines.en: I carry things in my robe hem; it works better.

lines.zh: 掉进水里的，才算我的。
lines.en: Only what falls into the water is mine.

lines.zh: 这枚符文是湿的，刚被人用过。
lines.en: This rune is wet; someone used it recently.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，只为看它会不会沉。
lines.en: I pick it up only to see whether it sinks.

lines.zh: 别在浅滩丢东西，我会捡走。
lines.en: Do not drop things in the shallows; I will take them.

lines.zh: 你踏进齐膝的水，我就知道了。
lines.en: You waded to your knees, and I knew.

lines.zh: 水把你身上的气味送到我这里。
lines.en: The water carries your scent to me.

lines.zh: 我选你，因为你走得太靠近水。
lines.en: I choose you because you walk too near the water.

lines.zh: 你在岸上犹豫的那一下，够了。
lines.en: That pause of yours on the shore was enough.

lines.zh: 我的符文亮了一下，选中你了。
lines.en: My rune glowed once; you are chosen.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只等你走进射程。
lines.en: I do not chase; I wait for you to enter range.

lines.zh: 你踩碎一枚贝壳，我在水里听见。
lines.en: You crushed a shell, and I heard it underwater.

lines.zh: 目标站在浅滩上，正合适。
lines.en: The target stands in the shallows. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我不挑，活的东西都算。
lines.en: I am not choosy; anything living counts.

lines.zh: 你已经站在我的水线之内。
lines.en: You are already inside my waterline.

lines.zh: 我退后半步，是为了看清你全身。
lines.en: I retreat half a step to see all of you.

lines.zh: 淡蓝的光在我掌心聚成一点。
lines.en: Pale blue light gathers into a point in my palm.

lines.zh: 你躲在岩石后，我的符文绕过去。
lines.en: You hide behind rock; my rune goes around it.

lines.zh: 我等浪起来，好遮住起手的动作。
lines.en: I wait for a wave to hide my casting.

lines.zh: 这个距离刚好，你够不到我。
lines.en: This distance is exact; you cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 你在数我的心跳，可我在水里。
lines.en: You count my heartbeat, but I am in the water.

lines.zh: 我抬手，水面跟着抬高。
lines.en: I raise a hand, and the water rises with it.

lines.zh: 别站在浅滩，那里没有遮蔽。
lines.en: Do not stand in the shallows; there is no cover.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，它们决定你往哪躲。
lines.en: I watch your feet; they decide where you dodge.

lines.zh: 这一发很快，你的盾来不及。
lines.en: This bolt is quick; your shield will be late.

lines.zh: 淡蓝的光出手，穿过整片雨。
lines.en: A pale blue bolt leaves my hand and cuts the rain.

lines.zh: 我不近身，我的攻击从远处来。
lines.en: I never close in; my strikes come from far away.

lines.zh: 这一发打在你肩上，像冰水。
lines.en: This bolt hits your shoulder like ice water.

lines.zh: 水花溅起，正好遮住第二发。
lines.en: The splash hides the second bolt.

lines.zh: 别躲向水面，那里是我的。
lines.en: Do not dodge toward the water; it is mine.

lines.zh: 我的符文碎了，你的护甲也裂了。
lines.en: My rune shatters, and so does your armor.

lines.zh: 一发不中，我就再等一个浪。
lines.en: One miss, and I wait for another wave.

lines.zh: 你听不见我的攻击，雨声太大。
lines.en: You cannot hear my attack; the rain is too loud.

lines.zh: 光打在你身上，留下湿的印。
lines.en: The light strikes you and leaves a wet mark.

lines.zh: 我打你的要害，不打你的盾。
lines.en: I strike your weak points, not your shield.

lines.zh: 我从浪里站起来，袍子还在滴水。
lines.en: I rise from the swell, my robe still dripping.

lines.zh: 暴风压低云层，我就在云下出现。
lines.en: The storm lowers the clouds, and I appear beneath them.

lines.zh: 水先动，然后才有我。
lines.en: The water moved first, and then I was here.

lines.zh: 我踩着浅滩上岸，脚没有声音。
lines.en: I step onto the shallows without a sound.

lines.zh: 潮水带来一枚海晶，还有我。
lines.en: The tide brought a shard of prismarine, and me.

lines.zh: 我的第一句话，被浪声盖住了。
lines.en: My first words were drowned by the surf.

lines.zh: 我在雨里睁开眼睛，很自然。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the rain, as if it were natural.

lines.zh: 这片海需要一个守它的人。
lines.en: This sea needed someone to keep it.

lines.zh: 我出现时，水面浮起一层蓝。
lines.en: When I appeared, a blue film rose on the water.

lines.zh: 我不记得自己来自哪片水。
lines.en: I do not remember which water I came from.

lines.zh: 火在水汽里挣扎，烧得我皮肤发响。
lines.en: Fire struggles in the steam and crackles on my skin.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上摔下，水接得不够软。
lines.en: I fall from the reef, and the water is not soft enough.

lines.zh: 我不该淹的，可这具身体会。
lines.en: I should not drown, yet this body does.

lines.zh: 气浪把我按进浪里。
lines.en: The blast presses me down into the swell.

lines.zh: 你的箭比我的符文快了一步。
lines.en: Your arrow came one step ahead of my rune.

lines.zh: 药水在我身上冒白汽，水火打架。
lines.en: Potion steams off me; water and magic quarrel.

lines.zh: 水喂不饱这具身体，它还是要饿。
lines.en: Water cannot feed this body; it still hungers.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，海水都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me, and the seawater lights up.

lines.zh: 掉下去时，我听见最后一声潮响。
lines.en: As I fall, I hear the tide one last time.
